name: CalHFA First-Time Homebuyer Programs
description: Fixed-rate mortgages and down payment assistance for first-time California homebuyers
fullDescription: The California Housing Finance Agency (CalHFA) offers 30-year fixed-rate mortgage loans and deferred-payment down payment assistance to help low- and moderate-income first-time homebuyers afford their first home.
whatTheyOffer:
- 30-year fixed-rate first mortgages (FHA, VA, USDA, and conventional)
- MyHome Assistance Program (deferred-payment loan up to 3.5% of the price for FHA loans, or 3% for conventional loans)
- CalHFA Zero Interest Program (ZIP) for closing costs
- MyAccess down payment or closing cost assistance (with CalPLUS Access loans)
- Shared appreciation loans such as California Dream For All (when funding is available)
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a first-time homebuyer (see CalHFA's definition)
2. Must meet income limits (vary by program and county)
3. Complete a homebuyer education and counseling course (eHome online, or a HUD-approved counseling agency)
4. Apply through a CalHFA Preferred Loan Officer or approved lender (CalHFA does not take applications directly)
5. Home must be your primary residence in California
keywords: CalHFA, first-time homebuyer, down payment assistance, mortgage, home loan, California, low-income, homeownership
